messages.subject: Whitcombe ET claim - engagement letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Gordon,

As promised, please find attached our engagement letter setting out scope, the team and our fees. If you're content, please sign and return the duplicate at your convenience. We've already started reviewing the ET1 and the consultation file Diane sent over.

We'll have a draft ET3 to you for comment by early next week.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Employment & Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
